newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis shares ends down, OTC trade active.
newsitem.headline: Tunis shares ends down, OTC trade active.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed 0.03 percent lower despite activity on the over-the-counter market, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 446.66 points, down from 446.79 on Monday.
Total volume was 5.14 million dinars against 766,521 dinars over the previous session. Over-the-counter exchanges amounted to 4.81 million dinars.
Societe Frigorifique et Brasserie de Tunis was down 1.58 dinar to 77 dinars.
Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF rose 0.27 dinar to 14.19 dinars.
Union Internationale de Banques was up 0.1 dinar to 11.1 dinars.
